overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Ultra Short-Term Bond ETF (TBUX) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on investment grade fixed income. TBUX is an actively-managed fund that invests in a diversified portfolio of investment-grade fixed income securities, targeting an effective duration of 1.5 years or less. TBUX was launched on Sep 28, 2021 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
